svg.title: From the car to the body shell
svg.desc: The 2010 2.9 carries its occupants within a joined shell between the axles. The sills run below the door openings; the floor and tunnel connect the open passenger compartment. Follow the lower shell, seat-support frames, bulkheads and reinforced windscreen frame. The rear cabin wall has a separate engine-access cover behind its trim; the fabric hood and luggage lids are other closures. Numbered parts: 1 Floor and crossmembers; 2 Seat-support frames; 3 Left sill; 4 Right sill; 5 Centre tunnel; 6 Front bulkhead region; 7 Rear cabin wall; 8 Rear-wall service cover; 9 Windscreen frame. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
